answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in meadow and velvet lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the zephyr graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1591 impostors cost 1099 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
